## Changes since 9.3.0-dzbarsky33

- [PR #59](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/59): Add the native `genaquery` rule to generate build inputs from action queries over a declared configured scope, without executing scoped actions. Support existing aquery output formats, parameter-file contents, source-template invalidation, and compressed results. Bind cached reports and their consumers to workspace/output/install directories so cached absolute paths and action hashes are not reused under different directories.
- [PR #58](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/58): Allow `bazel run --nobuild_runfile_manifests` to request manifest and symlink-tree actions for the executable and label-valued `--run_under` wrapper without changing the build configuration. Ordinary builds and tests still omit these manifests; repeated runs can reuse completed staging through the action cache.
- [PR #54](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/54): Recheck repository marker presence inside the R2C2 materialization task supplier. A caller arriving after another materialization completed no longer starts a duplicate operation with a missing marker.
- [PR #53](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/53): Apply cache-probe directory exclusions before recursive package loading, avoiding unnecessary evaluation of excluded BUILD files. Explicit positive targets and required dependencies remain loadable.
- [PR #56](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/56): Pre-size the remaining dirty-dependency set when no dependency groups have been consumed. Keep default allocation for partial suffixes to avoid reserving space for dependencies already processed.
- [PR #61](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/61): Reuse `RunfilesProvider.EMPTY` when both fields are exactly `Runfiles.EMPTY`, avoiding duplicate wrappers while preserving metadata on separately constructed empty runfiles. The source PR measured 27.72 MB lower mean retained heap in matched partial analyses; it did not establish an analysis-time or peak-RSS improvement.

[PR #47](https://github.com/dzbarsky/bazel/pull/47), which avoids temporary `RootedPath` interning during output metadata validation, was already included in release 33 and is retained unchanged.

### Validation

Twenty-one targeted test targets passed uncached on Linux remote execution, covering generated queries, action queries, configured queries, C++ analysis, package loading, dirty dependencies, repository materialization, runfiles, Starlark rule implementations, cache probes, and run integration. The remote-minimal `bazel run --nobuild_runfile_manifests` regression passed. After adding PR #61, `RunfilesTest`, `StarlarkRuleImplementationFunctionsTest`, `run_test`, `GenAqueryIntegrationTest`, and `GenCqueryIntegrationTest` passed again on the combined branch.

`BazelSkycacheIntegrationTest` passed 42 of 43 cases, including all new `genaquery` cache cases. The existing `buildCommand_uploadsFrontierBytesWithUploadMode` assertion still reports 8 configured targets versus a minimum of 9, the same failure previously reproduced on unchanged release 31. The assertion is unchanged. All 21 immutable-release publication checks passed.

### Release publication

Linux and macOS binaries for x86_64 and arm64 are built and version-checked before publication. The immutable release includes SHA-256 checksums and build-provenance attestations. Existing release tags and assets are preserved.
